name: Catherine Leung
life: “I still remember getting married in a chair with one short leg.” People around the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio know Catherine by a small Wednesday habit. Catherine notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I proposed to my second husband in the low chair. He bought the pair without telling me.
appearance: Catherine is easy to recognize by soft white hair brushed sideways and full cheeks and a mouth that pulls slightly to one side. Usually dressed in a faded indigo overshirt with a small enamel bird on the lapel, Catherine presses the lips together to keep a smile in when listening.
personality: Catherine treats a small promise with the gravity others reserve for a contract. This makes Catherine lovely to rely on and surprisingly difficult to invite on a whim.
agenda: To keep the low pair together in the new home.
family: Rowan Katz is Catherine’s second cousin. Catherine saves a place. Rowan chooses whether to use it. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The trust with a typo*, Rowan says, “I chose that nickname to survive school. Seeing it on bank stationery made me feel sixteen again.”
connections: Logan Walker. They compare the hidden repair to the actual curve left by a seated couple.

reactions.situation: Two visitors bid against each other for the porch chair
reactions.response: Catherine asks whether both people want the object itself or a particular memory of it.

reactions.situation: Smoke appears under a shop door after closing
reactions.response: Catherine alerts the nearest occupied shop, stays outside and writes down when the smoke first appeared.
